home.omen1: All things flow your way. Seize the opening and act; hesitation is the only real risk.
home.omen2: Helpful people gather around you and plans ripen. Cultivate friendships and stay upright.
home.omen3: The phoenix rises from fire. Hardship has forged you; hold your original intent and keep climbing.
home.omen4: The thaw has come and warmth returns. Kindness compounds — peace is found where the heart settles.
home.omen5: The boat meets wind mid-river. Defend rather than attack; patience turns danger into safety.
home.omen6: Autumn is shared and the moon is full. Gain and loss rest with heaven — do your part, release the outcome.
home.omen7: The flower is half open, not yet red. Store your strength and wait; do not force the season.
home.omen8: A blade sharpened ten years is drawn at last. Build inner skill, then move when the autumn wind rises.
home.omen9: Beyond the dark willows lies another village. The way out hides inside the blockage — let go and move freely.
home.omen10: A lone boat in night rain. Think thrice and move carefully; forcing things invites double trouble.
home.omen11: Withered lotus, rain, unfinished dreams. Do not reach for shortcuts; keep steady and preserve your peace.
home.omen12: Heavy frost, fading grass. Draw in your edge, travel quietly, and rise again when spring returns.
